title: 第二十一章 他们在找能入炉的活人第二十二章 守炉弟子死前藏下的令
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
为首的黑炉修士叫许鸦，瘦得像一截被烟熏干的药柴，脸上蒙着灰，眼窝深陷，偏偏身上压着炼气八层的气息。
他手里那块半碎令牌被黑色丝线缠着，像是从什么尸骸上硬剥下来的。
周荒只看一眼，就知道这不是完整丹令。
但它和石门凹痕的气息很像。
够用。
许鸦笑了笑。
“青木火莲在你们手上，青黑废丹珠也在你手上。小子，把东西交出来，我给你留个全尸。”
周荒没动怒，只看向顾清寒。
“顾师姐，黑炉的人都这么会说话？”
顾清寒剑尖垂下，语气冷得像执法堂石阶。
“他们一般只在活口面前这么说。死人听不见。”
沈青禾退后半步，指尖扣住一只药瓶。她不是战修，却很清楚自己该站在哪里，既不抢周荒身位，也不让黑炉轻易逼近。
许鸦扫了沈青禾一眼。
“炼丹堂的沈青禾？正好，乌先生说过，若能抓活的，价值比尸体高。”
乌先生。
这个名字一出口，顾清寒袖中的信符微微亮起。
周荒也记住了。
从血灵丹到焚脉砂，从阴骨花粉到青丹殿杀局，背后那只手终于露出一点影子。
许鸦察觉顾清寒的小动作，抬手一挥。
黑钉修士陈骨和另一名灰袍丹奴同时撒出黑灰。

灰尘落地，形成三道毒圈，封住三人退路。
沈青禾低声提醒：“焚脉砂改过的粉，沾上会让灵力逆行。”
周荒扯了扯嘴角。
“熟人啊。”
外门小比前的毒茶里，就有焚脉砂。
现在又来。
许鸦没有废话，黑铜短杖一挥，三枚丹钉同时射出。
一枚射沈青禾。
一枚射顾清寒。
一枚射向周荒腰间储物袋。
目标很明确。
人，证，物，都要。
这不是临时抢劫，是黑炉惯用的试验流程。先用毒粉封脉，再用丹钉定气，最后看活人能撑几息。
周荒脚下御风步一错，青木离火剑横扫。第一枚丹钉被剑锋挑飞，第二枚被顾清寒一剑挡下，第三枚却在半空炸开，化成一团黑雾扑向他的储物袋。
“想抢废丹珠？”
周荒反手取出一只普通废丹瓶，直接甩入黑雾。
瓶里装的是他早先收着的废毒丹残渣。
黑雾遇上废毒丹，竟迟疑了一瞬。
就这一瞬，周荒剑光已经到了许鸦眼前。
许鸦脸色一变。

他没想到周荒会拿废丹挡法器，更没想到这种破烂东西真能挡。
content_en:
The leader of the Black Furnace cultivators was named Xu Ya. He was as thin as a piece of firewood dried by smoke. His face was covered with dust and his eye sockets were sunken. However, he had the aura of the eighth level of Qi Refining on his body.
The half-broken token in his hand was wrapped in black silk thread, as if it had been torn off some corpse.
Zhou Huang knew with just one glance that this was not a complete elixir order.
But it is very similar to the smell of Shimen Dent.
Enough.
Xu Ya smiled.
"The Green Wood Fire Lotus is in your hands, and the Blue and Black Waste Pill Bead is also in your hands. Boy, hand over the things, and I will leave you a complete body."
Zhou Huang didn't get angry and just looked at Gu Qinghan.
"Senior Sister Gu, are all the people in Black Furnace so good at talking?"
Gu Qinghan lowered his sword tip and his tone was as cold as the stone steps of the law enforcement hall.
"They usually only say this in front of the living. The dead can't hear it."
Shen Qinghe took a half step back and clasped a medicine bottle with his fingertips. She was not a war cultivator, but she knew exactly where she should stand. She neither took Zhou Huang's position nor allowed Black Furnace to approach easily.
Xu Ya glanced at Shen Qinghe.
"Shen Qinghe from the Alchemy Hall? It just so happens that Mr. Wu said that if he can be caught alive, the value will be higher than the corpse."
Mr. Wu.
As soon as the name was spoken, the letter charm in Gu Qinghan's sleeve lit up slightly.
Zhou Huang also remembered it.
From Blood Spirit Pill to Burning Vein Sand, from Yin Bone Pollen to Qingdan Palace Killing Game, the hand behind his back finally showed a little shadow.
Xu Ya noticed Gu Qinghan's little movement and raised his hand.
Black-nailed monk Chen Gu and another gray-robed Danu spread black ashes at the same time.
Dust fell to the ground, forming three poisonous circles, blocking the three people's retreat.
Shen Qinghe reminded in a low voice: "Powder modified by Fenmai Sand will cause spiritual power to reverse course."
Zhou Huang twitched the corner of his mouth.
"An acquaintance."
There was Fenmai sand in the poisonous tea before Xiaobi at the outer gate.
Now again.
Xu Ya didn't talk nonsense. He waved the short black copper staff and shot out three pill nails at the same time.
One shot at Shen Qinghe.
One shot at Gu Qinghan.
One shot towards the storage bag on Zhou Huang's waist.
The goal is clear.
People, evidence, and things all matter.
This is not a temporary robbery, it is Black Hearth's usual experimental procedure. First use poisonous powder to seal the pulse, then use pill nails to stabilize the Qi, and finally see how long the living person can last.
Zhou Huang made a mistake with his wind-controlling step, and Qingmu Lihuo's sword swept across. The first pill nail was picked up by the sword's edge, the second one was blocked by Gu Qinghan's sword, but the third one exploded in mid-air and turned into a ball of black mist and rushed towards his storage bag.
"Want to grab the useless pill bead?"
Zhou Huang took out an ordinary useless elixir bottle with his backhand and threw it directly into the black mist.
The bottle contained the remains of the Waste Poison Pill that he had collected earlier.
When Hei Wu met the Waste Poison Pill, he hesitated for a moment.
At this moment, Zhou Huang's sword light was already in front of Xu Ya's eyes.
Xu Ya's expression changed.
He didn't expect Zhou Huang to use a waste elixir to block the magical weapon, let alone that such a broken thing could really block it.
